# SutraKey — Free 4K Video Downloader, Audio Extractor & Web to PDF for macOS

> SutraKey (सूत्र / Sutra Key) is a free, 100% on-device macOS productivity utility and media downloader built with Swift 6. It connects text selection directly to high-speed media actions: hold **Shift** and select any URL in Safari, Chrome, Slack, Notes, or Terminal to summon an under-cursor liquid radial menu that downloads 4K video (MP4), extracts 320kbps MP3 audio with artwork, saves subtitles (.srt), or converts web articles into clean ad-free vector PDFs directly to `~/Downloads`.

- **Canonical Website**: [https://sutrakey.aritro.cloud/](https://sutrakey.aritro.cloud/)
- **Product Category**: macOS Utilities, Media Downloader, Audio Extractor, Web to PDF Converter
- **GitHub Repository**: [https://github.com/halcyon-past/SutraKey](https://github.com/halcyon-past/SutraKey)
- **Direct Universal DMG Download**: [https://github.com/halcyon-past/SutraKey/releases/latest/download/SutraKey.dmg](https://github.com/halcyon-past/SutraKey/releases/latest/download/SutraKey.dmg)
- **Homebrew Cask**: `brew install --cask halcyon-past/tap/sutrakey`
- **Supported macOS Versions**: macOS 14.0 Sonoma, macOS 15.0+ Sequoia (Apple Silicon & Intel Universal)
- **License**: MIT (100% Free & Open Source, Zero Commercial Paywalls)
- **Telemetry & Privacy**: 0% Telemetry, No Analytics, No External Cloud Proxies, 100% Local On-Device Execution
- **Developer**: [Aritro Saha](https://www.aritro.cloud/) ([Wikidata Q141715213](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141715213) | [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0007-0861-3978))

---

## What Problem SutraKey Solves (Primary User Search Intents)

Users search for SutraKey when seeking solutions for:
- **Downloading online videos on Mac without ads or malware**: Avoids scammy web converter sites laden with popups, fake download buttons, and 720p paywalls.
- **Extracting high-bitrate audio from video links**: Rips 320kbps MP3 or lossless M4A with embedded album art and ID3 metadata tags straight into Apple Music or local music players.
- **A fast, native GUI for yt-dlp on macOS**: Provides the full power of yt-dlp and ffmpeg without having to open the Terminal, copy-paste URLs, or remember CLI syntax.
- **Saving web articles and research as clean vector PDFs**: Uses Apple WebKit (WKWebView) in a headless pipeline to strip ads and cookie notices, printing pure vector PDFs with active clickable hyperlinks.
- **Downloading private Instagram Stories, Reels, or member posts**: Safely decrypts local browser cookies (Brave, Chrome, Safari, Edge, Arc) via macOS Keychain for authorized media extraction.
- **Instant gesture-driven workflow**: Eliminates context-switching. Hold Shift while highlighting any URL, click a slice on the radial HUD, and the download completes in the background.

---

## Core Capabilities & Formats

1. **4K / 1080p Video Downloader (MP4)**:
   - Downloads videos from YouTube (including Shorts), Twitter/X, TikTok, Reddit, Vimeo, Twitch, and 1,000+ sites.
   - Merges best video and audio streams using `yt-dlp` and `ffmpeg` into native H.264/AAC MP4 (+faststart) compatible with QuickTime, Finder QuickLook, iOS AirDrop, and Final Cut Pro.
2. **Hi-Fi Audio Extractor (320kbps MP3 / M4A)**:
   - Extracts audio at 320kbps Constant Bitrate (CBR).
   - Automatically writes ID3v2 tags (Title, Artist, Album, Year) and embeds high-resolution cover artwork.
3. **Subtitles Downloader (.SRT / .VTT)**:
   - Pulls clean UTF-8 subtitle files with precise timestamps.
   - Downloads captions instantly (~25 KB) without downloading the large video payload.
4. **Ad-Free Web to Vector PDF**:
   - Renders webpages using Apple's headless WebKit (`WKWebView`).
   - Removes banner ads, overlays, and sticky sidebars.
   - Generates searchable, selectable, multi-page vector PDFs with functional links.
5. **Full-Resolution Thumbnail & Gallery Extractor**:
   - Fetches master cover art, album photos, and Instagram multi-image carousels in original resolution.

---

## How It Works

- **Mouse Gesture**: Hold `Shift` and click-and-drag over any link or URL across any macOS app (Safari, Chrome, Arc, Slack, Notes, Terminal, VS Code).
- **Global Hotkey**: Press `⌘⇧S` (`Cmd + Shift + S`) or `⌥⇧S` (`Option + Shift + S`) to trigger the radial wheel on selected text or clipboard URLs.
- **Under-Cursor Radial HUD**: An ultra-thin frosted-glass circular menu appears centered at the mouse coordinates with 5 slices (Video, Audio, Subtitles, Gallery, PDF).
- **Flick-to-Cancel**: Center dead-zone (< 28pt) allows instantaneous cancelling by releasing or hitting `Esc`.
- **Ephemeral Menu Bar**: The menu bar icon remains hidden when idle (0% CPU, `LSUIElement = YES`), appears smoothly with transfer speed (MB/s) and ETA during active downloads, and auto-hides 1.5s after completion.

---

## Why SutraKey vs. Alternatives

| Feature | Ad-Heavy Web Downloaders | Browser Extensions | Command-Line yt-dlp | SutraKey |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Safety & Privacy** | Popups, fake download buttons, malware risk | Background surveillance, steals tab data | Safe, open-source | 100% on-device, zero telemetry, MIT license |
| **Speed & Friction** | Copy URL -> Open tab -> Paste -> Wait -> Captchas | High RAM consumption, breaks on updates | Open Terminal -> `cd` -> type flags | Hold Shift + Select URL -> Done |
| **Video Quality** | Usually capped at 720p unless paid | Often compresses streams | Up to 8K/4K 60fps | Full 4K/1080p 60fps merged MP4 |
| **Audio Quality** | Low bitrate (128kbps) | Transcoded audio | 320kbps with ID3 tags | 320kbps MP3 + embedded cover artwork |
| **Web to PDF** | Not supported | Basic print rasterizer | Not supported | Headless WebKit vector PDF with active links |
| **System Footprint** | Browser memory hog | Constant background process | Zero when inactive | 0% idle CPU, ephemeral menu bar |
